```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
invisible(lapply(seq_len(nrow(SiteTable)), function(i) {
  SiteID <- SiteTable$siteID[[i]]
  SiteLabel <- SiteTable$label[[i]]

  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/contents.sdc.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "contents", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(TITLE = sprintf("Contents<br>Site: %s", SiteLabel)),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/deq.gistm.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "gistm", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = sprintf("GISTM Design Criteria<br>Site: %s", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/deq.ancold.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "ancold", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = sprintf("ANCOLD Design Criteria<br>Site: %s", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/deq.cda.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "cda", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = sprintf("CDA Design Criteria<br>Site: %s", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/asce.qmd",
    stem = paste(SiteTable$key[[i]], "asce", sep = "-"),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      siteID.target = SiteID,
      TITLE = sprintf("ASCE-7 Design Criteria<br>Site: %s", SiteLabel)
    ),
    root = root
  )
}))
```
